name: Install OpenCode CLI
description: Installs the OpenCode CLI onto the system PATH so it is available to the remote user. Uses the official installer (https://opencode.ai/install). By default installs the latest release; pass 'version' to pin a major (e.g., '1', '2') or specific release (e.g., '1.18.34', '0.0.55') or 'latest'. The binary is installed to /usr/local/bin so it works for any shell in the container without modifying rc files.

version.description: OpenCode release version to install. Can be 'latest', a major version like '2' or '1', or a specific version like '1.18.34' or '0.0.55'.
